summary.behavior: Damage accumulator for the deployable collapse grenade (self = grenade; registered as watcher.ondamage). Cancellation: self endon( #"death" ). Setup: damagemax = 50; self.damagetaken = 0. Infinite loop over damage events: waitresult = self waittill( #"damage" ); damage = waitresult.amount; type = waitresult.mod; weapon = waitresult.weapon; if ( !isdefined( self.damagetaken ) ) -> self.damagetaken = 0; attacker = self [[ level.figure_out_attacker ]]( waitresult.attacker ) â€” resolves the real attacker via the level function pointer (indirect call; resolved value not used afterwards in this span); damage = weapons::function_74bbb3fa( damage, weapon, self.weapon ) â€” weapon-vs-weapon damage adjustment helper called on the damage amount. Branch: if ( type == "MOD_MELEE" || type == "MOD_MELEE_WEAPON_BUTT" || weapon.isemp || weapon.destroysequipment ) -> self.damagetaken = damagemax (melee, melee-butt, EMP weapons, and weapons flagged destroysequipment instantly meet the threshold â€” equipment-killer filtering); else self.damagetaken += damage (accumulate). Exit: if ( self.damagetaken >= damagemax ) -> self detonate(); return â€” destroys/de-tonates the grenade after 50 accumulated or instant-trigger damage; loop otherwise continues.
